info.title: Meziantou.Framework.Templating.Tool
info.description: CLI to render templates using Meziantou.Framework.Templating

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to an input template file, or a glob pattern (*, ?, **) that matches template files. Can be repeated

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output file of a single template. If omitted, writes next to the template when its name is known, or to stdout

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: Directory of the generated files. A template matched by a glob pattern keeps its path relative to the start of the pattern

options.name: --output-extension
options.description: Extension of the generated file of a template that has no output directive

options.name: --root-directory
options.description: Directory the input paths and glob patterns are relative to. Defaults to the current directory

options.name: --arg
options.description: Argument passed to the templates, as name=value. The value is a string. Can be repeated

options.name: --arguments-file
options.description: Path to a JSON file whose root object holds the arguments passed to the templates

options.name: --start-code-block-delimiter
options.description: Delimiter that marks the start of a code block

options.name: --end-code-block-delimiter
options.description: Delimiter that marks the end of a code block

options.name: --output-encoding
options.description: Output encoding for generated files. Example: utf8, utf8-bom, unicode, utf-16, utf-32

options.name: --line-ending
options.description: Line ending to use in output. Values: LF, CRLF, CR
